definitions.explanation: The cosmetic effect of making skin appear lighter, more even-toned, or more luminous. A major concept in the Japanese beauty and skincare industry, referring to products that reduce spots, freckles, and dullness.

examples.japanese: この{化粧水|けしょうすい}には{美白効果|びはくこうか}がある。
examples.english: This toner has a skin-brightening effect.

examples.japanese: ビタミンCは{美白効果|びはくこうか}が{高|たか}いとされている。
examples.english: Vitamin C is considered to have strong skin-whitening effects.

examples.japanese: {美白効果|びはくこうか}を{謳|うた}う{製品|せいひん}は{多|おお}いが、{医薬部外品|いやくぶがいひん}として{認可|にんか}された{成分|せいぶん}が{含|ふく}まれているか{確認|かくにん}することが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: Many products claim skin-whitening effects, but it is important to check whether they contain ingredients approved as quasi-drugs.

notes:
Composed of {美白|びはく} (skin whitening/brightening) and {効果|こうか} (effect). {美白|びはく} literally means "beautiful white" and is a major marketing and beauty concept in Japan. In the Japanese cosmetics industry, {美白|びはく} is officially defined as "preventing melanin production and suppressing spots and freckles" rather than literally bleaching the skin.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Fair skin has historically been valued in Japanese aesthetics, reflected in the proverb {色白|いろじろ}は{七難隠|ななんかく}す ("fair skin hides seven flaws"). The modern {美白|びはく} industry is enormous, with dedicated product lines from every major cosmetics brand.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美白効果|びはくこうか}のある: having a whitening effect
- {美白効果|びはくこうか}が{高|たか}い: high whitening effect
- {美白効果|びはくこうか}を{期待|きたい}する: to expect a whitening effect
- {美白効果|びはくこうか}を{謳|うた}う: to advertise a whitening effect

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {美白|びはく}: skin whitening — the concept itself; often used as a modifier
- {美肌|びはだ}: beautiful skin — broader than whitening; includes smoothness, moisture, and overall skin quality
- {日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}め: sunscreen — a preventive product that helps maintain fair skin by blocking UV rays
- シミ: spots, dark spots — the blemishes that whitening products aim to reduce
